en.headline: Police transport vehicle catches fire on Yuen Long Highway, no injuries
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze in a police personnel carrier near Long Tin Road around 11am on Tuesday after reports of smoke while it was travelling towards Sheung Shui.
body: Police received a report at about 11:03am on Tuesday of a suspected fire in a police vehicle on Yuen Long Highway towards Sheung Shui near Long Tin Road.
Firefighters deployed two water jets and a breathing apparatus team and extinguished the fire by about 11:19am. The front of the vehicle, described as a personnel carrier, was blackened.
No one was injured. The Transport Department temporarily closed some lanes, causing traffic congestion in the area while the scene was cleared. Fire services are investigating the cause.

zh.headline: 元朗公路警車行駛中起火 消防救熄無人傷
zh.dek: 周二上午約十一時，元朗公路往上水方向近朗天路一輛運送警員的警車懷疑起火，消防出動兩條喉及煙帽隊灌救，約十六分鐘後救熄，無人受傷。
body: 警方周二上午約十一時零三分接報，指元朗公路往上水方向近朗天路有一輛警車懷疑起火。
消防到場出動兩條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，至約十一時十九分將火救熄，涉事俗稱「豬籠車」的警車車頭熏黑。
事件中無人受傷。運輸署因車輛着火暫時封閉部分行車線，現場交通一度繁忙。消防正調查起火原因。
